author: Claude
summary: All 81 trusted probes ran clean at this head, and the advisory checks are read correctly for the first time. The problem you can see right now is Chef: it pours backwards and piles flat shapes over the painted kitchen. Your report reopened it after this study ran, and it now tops the roadmap. The loop finishes its first turn when you answer the five questions below.

strengths.note: Nothing is lost and nothing is won by doing nothing: probe_passive and the other 80 trusted probes ran clean at this head.
Touching the world changes it where the child touches: the Day One bathroom dirt now clears along the scrub path (2 October).
The family's own voices stay untouched; new lines must use the separate synthetic Parler voices.
This cycle turned five lessons into checks the next change cannot skip, including the one behind the false CI failures.

weaknesses.item: Chef pours backwards and looks cluttered
weaknesses.action: The jug picture faces left but the code tips it to the right, so it pours from the handle; every step also piles a dark oval and flat shapes on top of the painted bowl, oven and cake. Reopened as MA-OPERA-001; Codex package CR0 has the exact fix.

weaknesses.item: Chef's pour may also never finish
weaknesses.action: Codex checks it with the same fix (CR1); the phone session asks you to look too.

weaknesses.item: Review screenshots fail on the CI computer
weaknesses.action: The Sky Lagoon, castle and dust-boss arena captures fail because that computer cannot draw with the phone's renderer (CR2); fixing it changes the CI workflow, so it needs your yes.

weaknesses.item: Opera pacing is measured for 4 of 15 jobs
weaknesses.action: Codex adds simulated play for the other ten kinds of activity (CR3).

weaknesses.item: Fixes still wait for a phone check
weaknesses.action: DEVICE_SESSION.md batches them into one 30-minute session; Chef left that list when your report reopened it.
